section_summary.extract_value: This section details the personality measures used, specifically the 44-item Big Five Inventory (BFI) by John, Donahue, & Kentle (1991). The BFI assesses the five-factor personality model, comprising subscales for neuroticism, extraversion, agreeableness, conscientiousness, and openness to experience, with responses collected on a 5-point Likert scale.
section_summary.evidence_source: The entire section text describes the Big Five Inventory and its subscales.
